faq.title: Questions we get asked a lot
faq.subtitle: Don't see your question here? Reach out on WhatsApp — we usually reply within minutes.

items.question: How much does the point-of-sale system cost?
items.answer: The POS has a single all-inclusive plan of $45 per month per branch: no stripped-down versions or extra charges per feature. Appointments & Booking costs $30 per month and Accounts Receivable (store credit) costs $25 per month, per business. Delivery has no fixed monthly cost: you pay a per-delivery commission based on your volume.

items.question: What's included in the monthly fee?
items.answer: Hosting, technical support, and all system updates at no extra cost. When we release improvements, you get them without paying anything extra.

items.question: Do I need to buy hardware?
items.answer: It's not mandatory. The system works with USB or network thermal printers and RJ11 cash drawers. If you prefer a turnkey solution, we offer a ready-to-use kit (computer with monitor, keyboard and mouse, receipt printer, cash drawer, and barcode scanner, installed and configured) starting at $600; the hardware is yours and flexible payment plans are available.

items.question: Does it work if the internet goes down?
items.answer: In single-terminal businesses, you can keep processing sales offline; transactions are saved locally and sync automatically once the internet is restored.

items.question: Can I accept payments in US dollars?
items.answer: Yes. You can charge in córdobas or US dollars, and change is calculated in córdobas using the exchange rate you define in the system.

items.question: How do I monitor cashier activity at the cash drawer?
items.answer: Each cashier counts their cash at shift close without seeing the expected total (blind closeout), and the system flags any discrepancy. Voids and returns require manager authorization, logging who performed the action and who approved it.

items.question: Does it work for restaurants and coffee shops?
items.answer: Yes. The same system manages tables and lets your servers take orders directly from their smartphone or a tablet; you don't need a separate app.

items.question: Can I import my products from Excel?
items.answer: Yes. You can import your entire product catalog from an Excel file and export it whenever you need to.

items.question: Does it issue official tax invoices (DGI)?
items.answer: Currently, the system issues sales tickets and receipts. Official electronic tax invoicing is not included for now; reach out on WhatsApp if you require it and we can review your specific case.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: POS, Booking, and Accounts Receivable are deployed within 1 week. A website is delivered in 1 to 3 weeks. Custom systems take 3 to 5 weeks, and larger projects take 1 to 3 months, with direct communication at every milestone.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We don't disappear after shipping: all our plans include ongoing technical support, and your software evolves alongside your business.

items.question: How much does a website or custom software cost?
items.answer: A professional website starts at $300 (one-time payment) and includes 2 months of maintenance and support; thereafter it's $30 per month. Custom systems are quoted based on your requirements: message us for a personalized, no-commitment quote.

items.question: Do you only work with businesses in Nicaragua?
items.answer: No, we work with clients across Latin America and worldwide. We are based in Nicaragua, but our software has no borders.
